page: Microsoft Azure EC8eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 8 dedicated vCPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance includes 472 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-speed local read and write capabilities directly on the host. Additionally, the server is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the EC8eds_v6 offers a balanced profile for workloads requiring a high memory-to-vCPU ratio without the overhead of a larger CPU footprint. The combination of dedicated compute cores, substantial RAM, and fast local NVMe storage makes this server type suitable for memory-intensive applications, relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and data analytics workloads.
